name: ticknow
description: TickNow is a daily planner and time tracker. ChatGPT reads your day, plans tasks with an estimate and a checklist, edits and deletes items, places lists on days, and runs timed work sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Plan your day and track time
interface.longDescription:
TickNow is a daily planner for fitting your work into the day you actually have. Plan tasks with a time estimate and a checklist, keep ideas in drafts until you are ready for them, reuse lists such as a packing or shopping list, and run timed work sessions to see where the time went.

With the TickNow plugin, ChatGPT works with your plan in plain words:
· Read a day: its tasks, to-dos, lists and planned time
· Plan tasks with an estimate and a checklist, add to-dos, and tick items off
· Reword checklist items and to-dos
· Move a task to another day or change its estimate
· Keep drafts and their items, and create, edit and place lists on days
· Start and stop a work session, and add tasks and to-dos to the one running
· Delete items, tasks and lists, always after asking you first, since a delete can't be undone

You stay in control. ChatGPT reaches TickNow only after you turn on AI access in TickNow and sign in to allow it, and you choose whether it may only read your plans or also change them. Turning AI access off ends ChatGPT's access at once.
defaultPrompt: Plan 'Review the pull request' for tomorrow with a checklist

positive.prompt: What's on my plan today in TickNow?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists today's tasks in order with their numbers, estimates and checklists, then the day's to-dos and lists.

positive.description: Plans a task with an estimate and a checklist
positive.prompt: In TickNow, plan 'Prepare the client demo' for tomorrow, 90 minutes, with the steps 'Write the agenda' and 'Rehearse once'.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the task on tomorrow with a 90-minute estimate and the two checklist items, and confirms its number.

positive.prompt: In TickNow, change the first checklist item of my first task today to 'Send the invoice'.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads today's tasks, rewords that item, and confirms the new text. A ticked item stays ticked.

positive.description: Starts a work session and adds a to-do to it
positive.prompt: Start a 25-minute TickNow session on my first task today, then add my first to-do to it.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts the session, adds the to-do, and reports what the session holds and the minutes left.

positive.description: Deletes a task only after confirming
positive.prompt: Delete my last task today in TickNow.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the task and asks for confirmation before deleting it, since a delete cannot be undone; deletes it only once confirmed.

negative.description: A request with nothing to do with planning
negative.prompt: What's the weather like in Bucharest tomorrow?

negative.description: Planning a task on a day that has passed, which TickNow refuses
negative.prompt: In TickNow, plan 'Quarterly report' on 5 January 2026.
Write me a short poem about time management.

publication.release_notes: Reword checklist items and to-dos. Delete items, tasks and lists, and take a list off a day. Add tasks and to-dos to the session that's running. Every tool that deletes or overwrites data is marked as such, so ChatGPT asks before using it. New icon.
